funnel.scope: Per-tick test-only observer. Both fusion parents retained. Closed depth counts consecutive non-founder links that matured, gathered as adults, produced a subsequent packet and contributed to a birth; founders start at depth0 and a merely born child does not close a loop. limitations: Selected seed91 placement; hand-written sensor-only policy, not an evolved genome. One-unit founder bodies and real inherited costs. No reserves or resource injections after initialization. No claim of indefinitely sustained population.
